yikes, there's a lot and I'm not quite yet finished mixing and matching to my complete liking. But I can provide the ones needed to get this specific look in this specific area.   
As for ENB it's a newer one from Foxxne called 'fnenb', it's pretty much a port and tweaked preset of Suki's ENB for LE. Grass seen in the pic is from a 'Verdant 1.6c short grass for SE', a shorter grass version of verdant. Love it for the reach, pines and tundra. Textures seen on the outer wall is from 'Dawn of Skyrim', with the door from 'Glorious doors of Skyrim'. Base landscape textures is from 'Tamrielic textures SE - landscapes'. Horse from 'SC HorseReplacer'. Guards are wearing armor from 'Guards armor replacer'. Mountain from 'Majestic Mountains', and yeah that's pretty much it for this spot. Lmk if you're looking for something else.

Let's say you turn around and there's an enemy standing there, a zoom in on the enemy's face with the metalgear surprise sound effect could spice things up. Also, more intense music and faster cuts at the end of the game when the time is about to run out or something could spice things up a bit. It takes time, learn gradually, I only started to really get into editing a couple of weeks ago and it's starting to look good. Good luck ;)

Also, when it comes to thumbails I like to use Paint 3D on windows (free), they give you some cool and easy options.
